pass.why: a transition retargets from the current value
a spring retargets with its current velocity
an opacity-only keyframe does not move the panel; the transition still retargets its position

fail.answer:
@keyframes slide-in { from { translate: -100% 0; } to { translate: 0 0; } }
.panel.is-open { animation: slide-in 300ms ease-out forwards; }
fail.why: the keyframe restarts from zero on each toggle

fail.answer:
@keyframes slide-out { from { translate: 0 0; } to { translate: -100% 0; } }
.panel.is-closing { animation: slide-out 300ms ease-out forwards; }
fail.why: closing starts a new keyframe from its first frame, not the current position
